headline: NIST’s new adversarial-ML draft adds a taxonomy for agentic-system attacks
summary: NIST’s 9 November initial public draft SP 2400-102e2026 extends its adversarial machine-learning taxonomy to agentic systems. Section 4 classifies attacks across workflow stages and attacker capabilities, including attacks using untrusted data and memory, malicious tools and skills, compromised agents in multi-agent systems, and long-horizon task persistence. NIST says the taxonomy is intended to inform future standards and practice guides; public comments are open through 18 December. This is a voluntary draft, not evidence of adoption or of defense effectiveness.
